retainedFailures.cause: Runtime assertion found incorrect sound field (sound instead of CE id); corrected export. Next placement overlapped retained failed fixture; new tests moved to chunk 20. Collision checks remain enabled. Two overlapping empty failed fixtures archived with the whole entity region before targeted cleanup; other entities preserved.
CE onLoad was called inside pre-spawn consumer with isValid=false; corrected lifecycle deferral. Failed entities and logs retained.

All first-cycle probes passed but CE shutdown exceeded supervisor grace period; forced exit did not persist new entity. Restart correctly failed missing-UUID check. Retained checkpoint/logs; subsequent clean cycles passed. Intermittent shutdown root cause unresolved.

fixtureCleanup.reason: Failed g/16 and overlapping g/17 fishrack fixtures, no stored fish in either CE data blob

limits: No player interactions, vanilla-client rendered screenshot proof or current Folia/intermediate-version acceptance.
30 legacy conversion warnings remain on 1.21.1: 27 Deco and 3 Cookery. These 27 Deco entries are also omitted from modern CMD output on old servers.
Final geometry and texture comparisons prove generated data, not client rendering or precise in-world alignment.
Interrupted/failed spawns during removal retain remaining fish in manual recovery/*.nbt; no automatic delivery.
Source missing textures/models, 26.3 Doll UV warnings, CE default palm-tree conversion and Windows OSHI performance counter error remain.
Cross-region movement/reload, protection plugins and complete player break paths remain unverified.
Many other scripted furniture behaviors remain unported; total project goal incomplete.
